summary: Landscape tabloid classifieds page built almost entirely of boxed, centred display ads under royal-blue header bars, with a deep red masthead block and a boxed column of statewide network liners on the right.

frame.masthead: Deep red block with huge white Didone caps CLASSIFIEDS; contact panel to the right in navy condensed sans (CONTACT / EMAIL / PHONE on hairlines).
frame.footer: Network badge (Advertising Networks of Florida) and a rounded 'Week of' date box.

headers.notes: Solid royal blue, white condensed sans in title case, centred. Fixed height regardless of column width.
Inside the network box: bold sans title-case subheads, no bar.

units.notes: Each line its own size; condensed sans for headings, regular sans for detail; phone in bold.

units.example: Need a RIDE? Call us at Welcome Taxi...
units.notes: Pale yellow fill; a pale green variant appears for WANTED!; asterisk bullets and Clarendon-style WANTED.

units.example: PROTECT YOUR HOME from pests safely and affordably...
units.notes: Syndicated statewide liners in a heavy-ruled two-column box; bold caps hook, ragged right, bold phone.
Full-colour stock-photo ad, yellow condensed display type.

type.look: Didone caps (Bodoni/Didot-like), white out of red

notes: Very few true liners; the page is a mosaic of small boxed displays. A good template for a 'local display' family variant.
